product.gasCreditNote: Gas refund only when depositSenior actually matches; scaled to matched/deposited. See docs/GAS_CREDIT.md.
product.treasuryCutNote: Treasury cut % of fees / junior-paid cover only. treasuryCutIsSet flag. Base 20%. Boost tiers 15/10/5. Creator fee later.
product.earlyExitCoverNote: Early exit: fees → junior lender balance → wallet → sell-shares. NO backstop. Reverts if cannot cover (non-SellShares).
product.settleCoverNote: Settle: backstop → junior idle → wallet → sell-shares → pool idle last resort. Treasury cut only on junior-paid cover.
product.autoCompoundNote: setAutoCompound(bool). Explicit withdrawUnmatched always wallet. Under $25 compound → wallet. Pause/caps do not brick exits.
product.accountingNote: v3 lender pool: internal shares, virtual offset, FIFO withdraw queue, floating rate index. See docs/ACCOUNTING_V3.md. v2.5 PROXY superseded.
